behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; the window loads 16 bytes at (rsi) and compares them against the .rodata constant

branches.match_path: all 16 bytes equal the constant (pmovmskb == 0xffff): return rdi+0x38

behavior.formula: chunk = bytes at (rsi), 16 bytes; if chunk == constant at 0x208300: return rdi+0x38; else: return 0
behavior.output_shape: one rax value per path, then ret; rax is rdi+0x38 on match, 0 otherwise

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_slots_note: one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend; the file stores 0 in the .data.rel.ro slot, applied only at load time
